## &#127912; The official colour of this homepage

::: gc-center
<span class="gc-swatch"><i></i><b>Lettuce Green</b><span>PANTONE 13-0324 TCX</span><span>#BED38E</span><span>rgb(190, 211, 142)</span></span>
:::

Every green on this site is that one Pantone chip, tinted for the panels and
shaded for the sidebar, with radish red `#C8395B`, butter yellow `#F0C040` and
ink blue `#1C4F7C` as the accents. The whole set is declared as custom
properties at the top of `assets/geocities/geocities.css` &mdash; change
`--lettuce` there and the site follows.

Two neighborhoods ship with it: **SalinasValley**, the house theme, named for
the Salad Bowl of the World; and **GrowthChamber**, which is what a controlled
plant experiment looks like from the inside &mdash; a black box, artificial
light, no daylight at all. The buttons are in the sidebar, and your choice is
remembered in this browser.
